references.text: Isaac's blessing to Jacob: peoples shall serve him and nations bow down to him, fulfilling the prophecy that the older shall serve the younger.
Isaac's words to Esau that he shall serve his brother, but one day break the yoke from his neck.
The Lord's word through Malachi: 'Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated' – confirmation of God's choice between the two brothers.
Paul quotes the prophecy that the older shall serve the younger as an example of God's sovereign election.
David subdued Edom, and the Edomites became David's servants – a historical fulfillment of the prophecy.
Obadiah's prophecy concerning Edom's fall and humiliation, in line with the prediction about the relationship between the two nations.
Esau is described as worldly because he sold his birthright – an example of despising God's promises.
